mcp.description: Read-only SQL Server diagnostic evidence for the MCP SQL Query Store workshop. Use configured summary views and bounded diagnostic procedures only.

WorkshopRunSummary.description: Read-only summaries of bounded workshop runs and measured comparison outcomes. TARGET values are not measurements; use only rows classified as LAB-MEASURED for observed results.

source.object-description: Curated projection of workshop run status, evidence classification, Query Store identifiers, and measured performance totals.

fields.name: RunID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the workshop run or comparison.

fields.name: ParentComparisonID
fields.description: Optional identifier linking a phase run to its parent comparison run.

fields.name: EvidenceClassification
fields.description: Evidence provenance classification; LAB-MEASURED denotes executed lab evidence and TARGET denotes a goal only.

fields.name: Phase
fields.description: Run phase: Baseline, Optimized, or Comparison.

fields.name: RunStatus
fields.description: Lifecycle status: Pending, Running, Completed, Failed, or Stopped.

fields.name: Outcome
fields.description: Final bounded outcome classification, or null until the run is classified.

fields.name: StartedAtUtc
fields.description: Run start timestamp in UTC.

fields.name: CompletedAtUtc
fields.description: Run completion timestamp in UTC, or null while incomplete.

fields.name: BaselineQueryID
fields.description: Query Store query identifier captured for the baseline procedure, or null when unavailable.

fields.name: BaselinePlanID
fields.description: Query Store plan identifier captured for the baseline procedure, or null when unavailable.

fields.name: OptimizedQueryID
fields.description: Query Store query identifier captured for the optimized procedure, or null when unavailable.

fields.name: OptimizedPlanID
fields.description: Query Store plan identifier captured for the optimized procedure, or null when unavailable.

fields.name: DurationMs
fields.description: Measured elapsed duration in milliseconds, or null when not recorded.

fields.name: CpuMs
fields.description: Measured CPU time in milliseconds, or null when not recorded.

fields.name: LogicalReads
fields.description: Measured logical page reads, or null when not recorded.

fields.name: Spills
fields.description: Measured spill quantity recorded by the workshop, or null when not recorded.

fields.name: WaitTimeMs
fields.description: Measured wait time in milliseconds, or null when not recorded.

WorkshopSampleSummary.description: Read-only time-series memory samples collected during bounded baseline and optimized phases. Values are observations only when their run is LAB-MEASURED.

source.object-description: Curated projection of workshop resource-pool, host, process, and SQL Server memory samples.

fields.name: RunID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the sampled workshop run.

fields.name: SampleSequence
fields.description: Positive sequence number unique within the run.

fields.name: SampledAtUtc
fields.description: Sample timestamp in UTC.

fields.name: Phase
fields.description: Measured phase: Baseline or Optimized.

fields.name: PoolTotalMemoryKB
fields.description: Total regular resource-semaphore memory for the workshop pool in KiB.

fields.name: PoolGrantedMemoryKB
fields.description: Memory currently granted from the workshop pool in KiB.

fields.name: PoolUsedMemoryKB
fields.description: Granted workshop-pool memory currently used in KiB.

fields.name: PoolAvailableMemoryKB
fields.description: Workshop-pool semaphore memory not currently granted in KiB.

fields.name: GrantUtilizationPercent
fields.description: Measured percent of pool semaphore memory granted, from 0.00 through 100.00.

fields.name: GranteeCount
fields.description: Number of requests holding grants in the regular workshop semaphore.

fields.name: WaiterCount
fields.description: Number of requests waiting for grants in the regular workshop semaphore.

fields.name: HostAvailableMemoryKB
fields.description: Physical memory available on the SQL host in KiB.

fields.name: ProcessPhysicalMemoryKB
fields.description: Physical memory used by the SQL Server process in KiB.

fields.name: TotalServerMemoryKB
fields.description: SQL Server Total Server Memory performance counter in KiB.

fields.name: TargetServerMemoryKB
fields.description: SQL Server Target Server Memory performance counter in KiB.

fields.name: SystemLowMemorySignal
fields.description: True when Windows reports a system low-memory signal.

fields.name: ProcessLowMemorySignal
fields.description: True when SQL Server reports a process physical low-memory signal.

GetMemorySnapshot.description: Returns one current read-only memory snapshot for the workshop resource pool regular semaphore and host. No parameters or parameter bounds apply; values are point-in-time evidence, not a completed benchmark.

source.object-description: Bounded diagnostic procedure that reads the workshop pool, SQL Server, process, and host memory DMVs without changing state.

fields.name: ResourcePoolID
fields.description: SQL Server identifier of the workshop Resource Governor pool.

fields.name: ResourcePoolName
fields.description: Resource Governor pool name; expected to be mcp_sql_workshop_pool.

fields.name: ResourceSemaphoreID
fields.description: Semaphore identifier; zero denotes the regular query-workspace semaphore.

fields.name: PoolTotalMemoryKB
fields.description: Total regular-semaphore memory in KiB.

fields.name: PoolGrantedMemoryKB
fields.description: Currently granted regular-semaphore memory in KiB.

fields.name: PoolUsedMemoryKB
fields.description: Currently used granted memory in KiB.

fields.name: PoolAvailableMemoryKB
fields.description: Regular-semaphore memory not currently granted in KiB.

fields.name: GrantUtilizationPercent
fields.description: Point-in-time granted memory as a percent of total semaphore memory.

fields.name: GranteeCount
fields.description: Current requests holding memory grants.

fields.name: WaiterCount
fields.description: Current requests waiting for memory grants.

fields.name: HostAvailableMemoryKB
fields.description: Host physical memory currently available in KiB.

fields.name: HostUsedMemoryKB
fields.description: Host physical memory currently used in KiB.

fields.name: ProcessPhysicalMemoryKB
fields.description: SQL Server process physical memory in use in KiB.

fields.name: TotalServerMemoryKB
fields.description: SQL Server Total Server Memory in KiB.

fields.name: TargetServerMemoryKB
fields.description: SQL Server Target Server Memory in KiB.

fields.name: SystemLowMemorySignal
fields.description: True when the operating system signals low physical memory.

fields.name: ProcessLowMemorySignal
fields.description: True when SQL Server signals low process physical memory.

fields.name: ProcessPhysicalMemoryLow
fields.description: SQL Server process physical-memory-low flag.

fields.name: ProcessVirtualMemoryLow
fields.description: SQL Server process virtual-memory-low flag.

fields.name: SystemPhysicalMemoryLow
fields.description: Operating-system physical-memory-low flag.

fields.name: SystemPhysicalMemoryHigh
fields.description: Operating-system physical-memory-high flag.

fields.name: SampledAtUtc
fields.description: UTC timestamp at which the snapshot was produced.

GetActiveWorkshopGrants.description: Returns active memory grants only for doubly scoped workshop sessions. Parameter bounds: Top is 1-100 and defaults to 20; RunID is optional and limits evidence to one workshop run.

source.object-description: Bounded DMV diagnostic for active or waiting query-memory grants from workshop-tagged sessions.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return; integer from 1 through 100.

parameters.name: RunID
parameters.description: Optional workshop run UUID; null returns all currently tagged workshop runs.

fields.name: RunID
fields.description: Workshop run identifier decoded from the tagged session.

fields.name: SessionID
fields.description: SQL Server session identifier holding or waiting for the grant.

fields.name: RequestID
fields.description: Request identifier within the session.

fields.name: RequestStatus
fields.description: Current SQL request status.

fields.name: RequestCommand
fields.description: Current SQL request command.

fields.name: RequestedMemoryKB
fields.description: Requested query workspace memory in KiB.

fields.name: GrantedMemoryKB
fields.description: Granted query workspace memory in KiB.

fields.name: RequiredMemoryKB
fields.description: Minimum required query workspace memory in KiB.

fields.name: IdealMemoryKB
fields.description: Optimizer-estimated ideal query workspace memory in KiB.

fields.name: UsedMemoryKB
fields.description: Current used portion of the grant in KiB.

fields.name: MaxUsedMemoryKB
fields.description: Peak used portion of the grant in KiB.

fields.name: QueueID
fields.description: Resource semaphore queue identifier.

fields.name: WaitOrder
fields.description: Position in the memory grant wait queue, or null when granted.

fields.name: WaitTimeMs
fields.description: Memory grant wait duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: QueryCost
fields.description: Optimizer query cost associated with the grant.

fields.name: DegreeOfParallelism
fields.description: Degree of parallelism for the request.

GetQueryStoreTopQueries.description: Returns bounded Query Store runtime evidence only for the baseline and optimized workshop procedures. Parameter bounds: StartUtc precedes EndUtc, the window is at most 24 hours, and Top is 1-100 with default 20.

source.object-description: Read-only bounded Query Store runtime aggregate for the two workshop procedure object identifiers.

parameters.name: StartUtc
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC start of the evidence window; must precede EndUtc.

parameters.name: EndUtc
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC end of the evidence window; no more than 24 hours after StartUtc.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return; integer from 1 through 100.

fields.name: QueryID
fields.description: Query Store query identifier for a configured workshop procedure.

fields.name: PlanID
fields.description: Query Store plan identifier for the query.

fields.name: ProcedurePhase
fields.description: Workshop procedure phase: Baseline or Optimized.

fields.name: ExecutionCount
fields.description: Executions represented by overlapping Query Store intervals.

fields.name: AverageDurationMicroseconds
fields.description: Execution-count-weighted average duration in microseconds.

fields.name: AverageCpuMicroseconds
fields.description: Execution-count-weighted average CPU time in microseconds.

fields.name: AverageLogicalReads
fields.description: Execution-count-weighted average logical page reads.

fields.name: AverageQueryMaxUsedMemoryPages
fields.description: Execution-count-weighted average maximum query memory used in 8-KiB pages.

fields.name: AveragePhysicalReads
fields.description: Execution-count-weighted average physical page reads.

fields.name: AverageLogBytesUsed
fields.description: Execution-count-weighted average transaction log bytes used.

fields.name: AverageTempdbSpaceUsedPages
fields.description: Execution-count-weighted average tempdb space used in 8-KiB pages.

GetQueryStoreWaits.description: Returns bounded Query Store wait evidence only for the baseline and optimized workshop procedures. Parameter bounds: StartUtc precedes EndUtc, the window is at most 24 hours, and Top is 1-100 with default 20.

source.object-description: Read-only bounded Query Store wait-category aggregate for the two workshop procedure object identifiers.

parameters.name: StartUtc
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC start of the evidence window; must precede EndUtc.

parameters.name: EndUtc
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC end of the evidence window; no more than 24 hours after StartUtc.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return; integer from 1 through 100.

fields.name: QueryID
fields.description: Query Store query identifier for a configured workshop procedure.

fields.name: PlanID
fields.description: Query Store plan identifier for the query.

fields.name: ProcedurePhase
fields.description: Workshop procedure phase: Baseline or Optimized.

fields.name: WaitCategory
fields.description: Query Store wait category description.

fields.name: TotalQueryWaitTimeMs
fields.description: Total Query Store wait time in milliseconds for the category and selected intervals.

fields.name: AverageQueryWaitTimeMs
fields.description: Average wait time in milliseconds per represented execution.

GetProcedurePlanSummary.description: Returns bounded Query Store plan metadata for one workshop procedure. Parameter bounds: ProcedureName is exactly lab.usp_MonthEndSalesBaseline or lab.usp_MonthEndSalesOptimized; Top is 1-100 with default 20. PlanHash is evidence identity, not proof of performance.

source.object-description: Read-only bounded Query Store plan summary for only the baseline or optimized workshop procedure.

parameters.name: ProcedureName
parameters.description: Exact two-part name: lab.usp_MonthEndSalesBaseline or lab.usp_MonthEndSalesOptimized.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Maximum plans to return; integer from 1 through 100.

fields.name: QueryID
fields.description: Query Store query identifier for the selected workshop procedure.

fields.name: PlanID
fields.description: Query Store plan identifier.

fields.name: IsForcedPlan
fields.description: True when Query Store currently forces this plan.

fields.name: HasForceFailures
fields.description: True when Query Store records one or more force failures.

fields.name: LastForceFailureReason
fields.description: Most recent Query Store plan-force failure reason, or NONE when no failure is recorded.

fields.name: IsParallelPlan
fields.description: True when the captured plan uses parallel execution.

fields.name: LastExecutionTime
fields.description: Most recent Query Store execution timestamp for the plan.

fields.name: PlanHash
fields.description: SHA-256 hash of the stored query plan bytes for evidence correlation.

fields.name: PlanSizeBytes
fields.description: Stored query plan size in bytes.

CompareWorkshopRuns.description: Compares one completed, frozen workshop comparison using exactly twelve correct paired trials. Parameter bounds: RunID and ValidationBatchID are required UUIDs. Returns measured peak and median grant utilization plus duration, CPU, reads, spills, waits, regression flags, and final evidence outcome.

source.object-description: Read-only evidence comparison that validates a completed comparison run and its exact validation batch before calculating outcomes.

parameters.name: RunID
parameters.description: UUID of a completed Comparison-phase workshop run with frozen settings and both phase samples.

parameters.name: ValidationBatchID
parameters.description: UUID of the validation batch containing exactly twelve correct paired trials for RunID.

fields.name: RunID
fields.description: Completed comparison run identifier.

fields.name: BaselinePeakGrantUtilizationPercent
fields.description: Maximum measured baseline grant utilization percent.

fields.name: OptimizedPeakGrantUtilizationPercent
fields.description: Maximum measured optimized grant utilization percent.

fields.name: BaselineMedianGrantUtilizationPercent
fields.description: Median measured baseline grant utilization percent.

fields.name: OptimizedMedianGrantUtilizationPercent
fields.description: Median measured optimized grant utilization percent.

fields.name: BaselineDurationMs
fields.description: Mean measured baseline trial duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: OptimizedDurationMs
fields.description: Mean measured optimized trial duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: BaselineCpuMs
fields.description: Mean measured baseline trial CPU time in milliseconds.

fields.name: OptimizedCpuMs
fields.description: Mean measured optimized trial CPU time in milliseconds.

fields.name: BaselineLogicalReads
fields.description: Mean measured baseline trial logical reads.

fields.name: OptimizedLogicalReads
fields.description: Mean measured optimized trial logical reads.

fields.name: BaselineSpills
fields.description: Mean measured baseline trial spilled KiB.

fields.name: OptimizedSpills
fields.description: Mean measured optimized trial spilled KiB.

fields.name: BaselineWaitTimeMs
fields.description: Mean measured baseline trial wait time in milliseconds.

fields.name: OptimizedWaitTimeMs
fields.description: Mean measured optimized trial wait time in milliseconds.

fields.name: CorrectnessPassed
fields.description: True only when all twelve paired trials passed correctness validation.

fields.name: HasMaterialRegression
fields.description: True when an optimized secondary metric regressed by more than ten percent.

fields.name: HasAdditionalMetricImprovement
fields.description: True when at least one secondary metric improved by at least ten percent.

fields.name: DurationImprovedMaterially
fields.description: True when mean optimized duration improved by at least ten percent.

fields.name: CpuImprovedMaterially
fields.description: True when mean optimized CPU improved by at least ten percent.

fields.name: LogicalReadsImprovedMaterially
fields.description: True when mean optimized logical reads improved by at least ten percent.

fields.name: SpillsImprovedMaterially
fields.description: True when mean optimized spills improved by at least ten percent.

fields.name: WaitsImprovedMaterially
fields.description: True when mean optimized wait time improved by at least ten percent.

fields.name: MedianUtilizationReductionPoints
fields.description: Baseline minus optimized median grant utilization in percentage points.

fields.name: Outcome
fields.description: Evidence-based final outcome classification; target bands alone never imply measured success.
